# Bakasana

> The social app for a yoga practice you want to return to.

Bakasana is a practice app for iPhone and Android. The sun salutation timer on this site is free in the browser and does not need an account.

## Practices

- [Sun Salutation](https://bakasana.app/practices/sun-salutation/v1/): Free in-browser Surya Namaskar timer. Twelve poses, one breath each. Set each pose to 3, 4, or 5 seconds, then repeat for 5, 10, 20, 50, or 108 cycles. Sound can be a tick, a bowl, breath, or a voice that names the pose.

## Guides

- [Surya Namaskar, and Why to Practice It with Bakasana](https://bakasana.app/guides/surya-namaskar/): What the twelve-pose sun salutation is, and how the timer keeps the count, the pace, and the cycle.
